hero.heading: Train your team.
hero.subheading: Your stylists already know how to style hair. We bring specialised scalp and hair-support treatment knowledge directly to your salon — so your team can offer more, serve clients better, and create another reason for them to return.

whatWeTrain: Understanding different hair and scalp concerns
Herbal, seed and natural-based treatment approaches
Dry, itchy, oily and congested scalp support
Hair retention and healthy hair-care routines
How to recommend the right treatment for each client's individual needs

packages.name: TRAIN
packages.description: Your team learns the treatment process — scalp and hair consultation, assessment, application and aftercare — so they can support clients with confidence from day one.

packages.name: TRAIN + BUILD
packages.description: Everything in Train, plus we help you turn that knowledge into real services for your menu — names, descriptions and a pricing strategy built around your salon and clientele.

packages.name: TRAIN + LAUNCH
packages.tagline: Training + menu + launch strategy + team implementation
packages.description: Everything in Train + Build, plus a launch strategy and hands-on support getting your team and clients using the new services from week one.

treatments.name: Root Reset
treatments.description: A personalised scalp-support treatment designed to refresh the scalp and create a healthy foundation for the hair-care routine.

treatments.name: Scalp Clarity
treatments.description: A targeted scalp-care service for clients experiencing excess oil, product build-up, dryness or scalp discomfort.

treatments.name: Crown Restore
treatments.description: A focused treatment supporting clients experiencing breakage, fragile areas and hairline concerns.

treatments.name: Growth & Retention Therapy
treatments.description: A personalised treatment focused on scalp care, moisture, reduced breakage and helping clients maintain the length they grow.

treatments.name: Herbal Crown Ritual
treatments.description: A premium herbal and seed-based hair and scalp treatment inspired by African hair-care wisdom.

treatments.name: The Complete Crown Experience
treatments.description: A consultation-led treatment combining scalp care, hair support and personalised aftercare guidance.

treatmentsNote: Treatment names and services can be customised to suit your salon's brand, clientele and pricing structure.
